input.rationale: Payment captured on 2026-09-15 for student Krishna Pandey (notes) matches invoice INV-00079 for customer Krishna Pandey (CUST00067). Both amounts are 12,000,000 paise. Invoice was issued 2026-09-10 and is open. Payment and invoice customer names align exactly.
